articles.title: In Sun Belt Multifamily, an Uneven Path Back Toward Boom Times
articles.narrative: The Sun Belt multifamily market is experiencing an uneven recovery from a pandemic-era construction boom and subsequent oversupply, with different regional markets returning to normal conditions at varying rates. While rent growth surged 30% from 2021 to 2024 and new inventory increased by 673,000 units, the anticipated absorption within two years has not occurred uniformly. Industry experts now project positive rent growth for all major high-supply markets by year-end 2027, a revision from earlier forecasts. The market's complexity is further compounded by recent interest rate hikes, which are altering development and investment calculations. Despite a general slowdown in migration to the Sun Belt, some markets like Phoenix and Las Vegas are still seeing increased domestic inflows, while others like Tampa and Orlando have experienced significant drops. The decline in national multifamily construction starts, particularly in the Sun Belt, signals a rebalancing market, with starts in early 2026 falling to 2016 levels.
articles.market_intelligence: Yardi Matrix originally expected high-supply markets to return to positive rent growth by the end of 2026, but revised this to year-end 2027. The Federal Reserve's September interest rate hike of a quarter percentage point is impacting developer and investor calculations. Domestic renter mobility fell to 21.6% in 2026, down from 26.7% in 2014. First-quarter 2026 multifamily starts nationwide were 55,000 units, the lowest quarterly level since 2011 and 73% below the early 2022 peak. Sun Belt construction starts in early 2026 were roughly 75% below their 2022 high, and units under construction have fallen to 2016 levels. Sun Belt markets Orlando, Austin, Miami, Nashville, and Phoenix still face a pipeline imbalance, with a further 4% to 5% expected to be added to rental housing stock in certain metros in 2026 and 2027.

articles.title: Arrow Hires Yanni Marmarou to Grow N.J. Business
Proof Stacking — Or, the Compounding Value of Credibility in Business
articles.narrative: This article, authored by a veteran commercial real estate broker, introduces the concept of "proof stacking" as a method for building credibility in business. The author argues that in an increasingly digital world where expertise is easily claimed, true credibility is established not through singular achievements or assertions, but through the consistent accumulation of credible evidence over time. This includes a documented track record, demonstrated market knowledge, professional conduct, and a history of keeping commitments, all of which collectively make trust a logical conclusion for clients. The author draws on his experience at Massey Knakal to illustrate how systematic efforts, like quarterly market newsletters, contributed to this compounding credibility, emphasizing that reputation is built through behavior and thousands of interactions, not just accomplishments.

articles.title: Custom Data Requests Don’t Have to Stymie Commercial Real Estate Teams
articles.narrative: This article argues that despite significant investment in commercial real estate software, fulfilling custom data requests remains a manual and time-consuming process for CRE teams. The author contends that traditional enterprise software solutions, which attempt to force all business units into a single standardized dashboard, fail to account for the diverse reporting needs and metric definitions across different departments (e.g., property management, asset management, underwriting). Instead of static software, the article suggests that operators should build context-aware AI infrastructure beneath their existing systems, allowing teams to reliably build and modify workflows while maintaining data governance. This approach, exemplified by Friedman Real Estate, frees analysts from repetitive tasks and creates an operational knowledge base that can adapt to dynamic market demands and investor needs.

articles.title: Developer Joe Moinian On His Hudson Yards Project, AI’s Impact and Land Buys
articles.narrative: Joe Moinian, founder and CEO of The Moinian Group, is advancing plans for a 1.9 million-square-foot Class A office building at 3 Hudson Boulevard in New York City's Hudson Yards. The project, designed by FX Collaborative, is currently in discussions with a major anchor tenant to secure construction financing. Moinian also revealed plans for Site K, an adjacent development that will include 1,540 apartments and a five-star hotel, aiming to surpass the unit count of his firm's Sky residential tower. He noted that current tax incentives and high interest rates pose challenges for new developments, but his firm benefits from owning land acquired at lower costs years ago.

data_points.notable_features: Class A office building designed by FX Collaborative.
data_points.project_notes: Foundation has been dug; currently in discussions with a major anchor tenant to secure construction mortgage.

articles.title: Mohr Capital Breaks Ground on 371,388 SF Warehouse in East Houston
articles.narrative: Mohr Capital has commenced construction on Oates 610, a 371,388-square-foot warehouse facility in East Houston. The project is strategically located at the intersection of major highways, offering excellent logistical access. The facility is designed with modern industrial features, including a cross-dock configuration and high clear heights, with completion anticipated in the second quarter of next year.

data_points.notable_features: Cross-dock configuration, 36-foot clear heights, 80 dock doors, 91 trailer storage stalls. Located at the intersection of I-610, I-10, and U.S. Highway 90.

articles.title: American Landmark Acquires 292-Unit Apartment Complex in Southeast Houston
articles.narrative: American Landmark, an owner-operator based in Tampa, has acquired Toscana Parkway, a 292-unit apartment complex in southeast Houston. The property, built in 2009, offers a variety of unit sizes and amenities. The new owner plans to implement capital improvements to the complex.

data_points.notable_features: Amenities include a pool, fitness center, sauna, clubhouse, business center, volleyball court, children’s playground and poolside grilling areas.

articles.title: JLL Arranges $237.7M Loan for Life Sciences Campus in Research Triangle Park
articles.narrative: JLL has arranged a $237.7 million loan from Starwood Property Trust for King Street Properties to finance Phase I of Pathway Triangle, a life sciences and advanced manufacturing campus in North Carolina's Research Triangle Park. Phase I includes four buildings totaling 581,789 square feet, with two buildings already completed and 73 percent leased, and the remaining two buildings recently commencing construction. The campus is strategically located in a key life sciences hub, with strong preleasing activity for its advanced manufacturing and lab spaces.

data_points.notable_features: Life sciences and advanced manufacturing campus located in Research Triangle Park.
data_points.project_notes: Phase I includes two completed buildings (377,111 SF) and two buildings under construction (148,434 SF and 56,244 SF). Building 7 is fully preleased to Novartis.

articles.title: Cushman & Wakefield Brokers Sale of 104,250 SF Industrial Park in Denton, Texas
articles.narrative: Cushman & Wakefield has brokered the sale of M380 Business Park, a 104,250-square-foot industrial park in Denton, Texas. Box Investment Group sold the fully leased, three-building shallow-bay property to Lanihau Properties. The transaction highlights continued investor interest in industrial assets in the North Texas market.

articles.title: Wegmans to Open 110,000 SF Grocery Store in Charlotte This Week
articles.narrative: Wegmans is set to open a 110,000-square-foot grocery store in Charlotte, North Carolina, on October 14. The store will serve as an anchor for Northwood Investors' 2,000-acre master-planned development, Ballantyne. This new location will feature a wide array of traditional grocery departments, prepared food options, and a market café with seating, and has created 450 new jobs.

data_points.address: 11550 N. Community House Road, Charlotte, NC
data_points.notable_features: Anchor tenant of the 2,000-acre master-planned Ballantyne development; includes a market café with indoor and outdoor seating.

articles.title: Oxford Partners closes 4,693-square-foot lease renewal in Houston
articles.narrative: Cotemar International LLC has renewed its 4,693-square-foot office lease at 10370 Richmond Ave. in Houston. Oxford Partners represented the tenant in the transaction, while Stream Realty represented the landlord, FSP Westchase LLC.

articles.title: Berkadia brokers sale of 458-unit multifamily property in Mount Pleasant
articles.narrative: Santefort Real Estate Group, LLC has acquired Tivoli Green, a 458-unit luxury multifamily property in Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin, from Wangard Partners, Inc. Berkadia facilitated both the sale and the acquisition financing through Freddie Mac. Wangard Partners will continue to manage the property, which is one of the largest multifamily assets built in Southeastern Wisconsin in the last 25 years and is strategically located in an area experiencing significant economic expansion and job growth.

data_points.notable_features: Luxury multifamily property with 100% direct-access units and two-story townhomes, located in an area with significant economic expansion and job growth along the I-94 Corridor.
data_points.project_notes: Delivered in three phases from 2021 to 2024, it was the first apartment community built in Racine County in over 20 years.

articles.title: Northmarq arranges $50 million in financing for 235-unit apartment community in Bloomington
articles.narrative: Northmarq's Minneapolis Debt + Equity team successfully arranged $50 million in bridge loan financing for Ardor on the Bluffs, a 235-unit luxury multifamily community in Bloomington, Minnesota. The financing, secured through a life insurance company, is structured as a three-year loan with extension options. The property, completed in December 2024, offers a strong amenity package and is strategically located near major transportation hubs and employment centers, underscoring the continued demand for high-quality multifamily assets in the Bloomington market.

data_points.notable_features: Six-story luxury multifamily community with studio, one-, and two-bedroom homes, some with in-unit fireplaces, built-in desks, quartz countertops, and patios. Amenities include lounges, party rooms, a spa, pool, fitness center, underground parking, and river valley views. Located minutes from MSP International Airport and the Mall of America.
data_points.project_notes: The loan is a three-year bridge loan with extensions.

articles.market_intelligence: The Bloomington market continues to support the appeal of high-quality multifamily housing due to its access to major transportation infrastructure and proximity to large retail, hospitality, and employment destinations.

articles.title: Lee & Associates closes 10,000-square-foot industrial lease in Haltom City
articles.narrative: Lee & Associates Dallas-Fort Worth recently facilitated a new lease agreement for a 10,000-square-foot industrial property in Haltom City, Texas. The tenant, Elasco Urethane, an experienced leader in polyurethane elastomer technology, secured the space. The landlord, SE & AE Investments, was represented by LanCarte Commercial.

articles.title: Brixton Capital closes sale of Dow Texas Innovation Center in Lake Jackson
articles.narrative: Brixton Capital has sold the Dow Texas Innovation Center, a 664,100-square-foot research and development campus in Lake Jackson, Texas, to ExchangeRight Essential Income REIT. The 34-acre campus, comprising four buildings, is fully leased to The Dow Chemical Company under a single-tenant, triple-net lease. The transaction was structured as an UPREIT and debt-assumption deal.

data_points.address: 220, 230, 240 & 270 Abner Jackson Parkway, Lake Jackson, TX
data_points.notable_features: Four buildings ranging from two to four stories, fully leased to an investment-grade tenant.
data_points.project_notes: The sale was completed through a structured UPREIT and debt-assumption transaction.

articles.title: U.S. REITs Raise $20B in Q3 2026; IPO Market Cools
articles.narrative: U.S. REITs raised nearly $20 billion in the third quarter of 2026 through secondary debt and equity offerings, maintaining a similar pace to the previous quarter. Year-to-date capital raising reached $65.7 billion, comparable to the $67.9 billion raised through Q3 2025. The majority of Q3's capital came from debt offerings, while the REIT IPO market saw no activity after a busy first half of the year. Rising borrowing costs were noted, with the weighted average coupon for REIT debt increasing to 5.4% in Q3 from 4.7% in Q1.

articles.title: BH Properties Affiliate Acquires 346-Unit Leander Multifamily Project
articles.narrative: Haven Housing, the affordable and multifamily housing platform of BH Properties, has acquired The Evergrove at Crystal Village, a 346-unit, Class-A apartment community in Leander, TX. Completed in 2024, the garden-style property is approximately 92% occupied and is part of the larger Crystal Village master-planned, mixed-use community. This acquisition expands Haven Housing's Texas portfolio, reflecting their strategy of long-term ownership to provide stable housing and create value.

data_points.notable_features: Class-A, garden-style apartment community located within the Crystal Village master-planned, mixed-use community, offering private balconies or patios, a swimming pool with cabanas, a 24-hour fitness center, and a co-working clubhouse.

articles.title: Kolter Urban Reveals Plans for 325-Unit St. Pete Condo Project
articles.narrative: Kolter Urban has submitted plans for a significant condominium project in St. Petersburg, proposing two 44-story towers with 325 condo units, nearly 18,000 square feet of commercial space, and a 519-space parking garage. This $325 million redevelopment will replace the existing Hilton St. Petersburg Bayfront hotel, which Kolter acquired earlier this year for $96 million. The project underscores continued luxury residential development in the market.

data_points.notable_features: The project includes 17,988 square feet of commercial space and a 519-space parking garage.
data_points.project_notes: The 2-tower project will replace the existing 15-story Hilton St. Petersburg Bayfront hotel. The 3.01-acre site was previously acquired by Kolter for $96 million earlier this year.

articles.title: GID Pays $120M for Charlotte Warehouse Portfolio
articles.narrative: GID has acquired a nine-building warehouse portfolio and an undeveloped parcel within Woodland Business Park in Charlotte for $119.5 million. The transaction was financed by Capital One. The seller, La Caisse, had originally purchased the properties in 2017 for $51 million, indicating a significant appreciation in value for the industrial assets.

data_points.notable_features: Located near the junction of Interstate 85 and Interstate 77.
data_points.project_notes: The seller, La Caisse, acquired the properties in 2017 for $51 million.

articles.title: Aimco Advancing Luxury Edgewater Apartments
articles.narrative: Aimco is proceeding with the development of FIVESIXTY Waterfront Residences + Club, a luxury residential tower in Miami's Edgewater neighborhood. The project will feature 114 units with rents ranging from $15,000 to over $25,000, and is expected to achieve initial occupancy in spring 2027. The property will offer extensive amenities including a bayfront pool, private marina, fitness facilities, and executive work suites.

data_points.notable_features: Luxury waterfront property with a private marina accommodating vessels up to 70 feet, fitness and spa facilities, padel court, golf practice facilities, and private executive work suites. Residences range from 2,300 to 3,000 square feet. Located adjacent to the Miami Design District with easy access to Miami Beach, Downtown, Brickell, Wynwood, and Midtown.

articles.title: Battersea Power Station Lands £280M Refinancing For Final Phases
articles.narrative: Battersea Power Station has secured a £280 million refinancing package from a consortium of banks to fund the ongoing development of its final 16 acres. This significant loan will support the completion of the remaining phases of the iconic London project.

articles.title: Microsoft Sues JLL For Protection Against Lawsuit At NYC Office Project
articles.narrative: Microsoft has filed a lawsuit against JLL, seeking protection and coverage for potential damages stemming from a separate lawsuit initiated by a construction worker who sustained injuries at a New York City office project. Microsoft's legal action asserts that JLL, as the project manager, should bear responsibility for the worker's claims.

articles.title: Receiver Appointed For X Denver Apartment Building Near Coors Field
Social Housing Providers Turn To Bond Markets To Fund Expansions
articles.narrative: Social housing providers are increasingly leveraging bond markets to finance their expansion efforts, a strategy driven by rising operational costs and reductions in traditional funding sources. Despite these financial pressures, the sector has demonstrated stable margins, which is a key factor in its ability to attract bond market investment, according to S&P Ratings.

articles.title: Terra Lands $507M Loan For Miami Beach Condo Tower: The South Florida Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Tyko Capital has provided a substantial $507 million loan for the development of a new condominium tower in Miami Beach. This financing follows JDS Development's departure from the project, indicating a new phase for the residential development.

data_points.project_notes: JDS Development previously exited the project.
